description: This file defines the internal hook API for jemalloc, including hook types, enums, function pointer types, and function declarations for installing, removing, and invoking hooks related to memory allocation, deallocation, and expansion.

methods.name: hook_boot
methods.description: Initializes the hook system, returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: hook_install
methods.description: Installs hooks and returns an opaque handle for removal.

methods.name: hook_remove
methods.description: Removes previously installed hooks using the handle.

methods.name: hook_invoke_alloc
methods.description: Invokes the allocation hook with specified parameters.

methods.name: hook_invoke_dalloc
methods.description: Invokes the deallocation hook with specified parameters.

methods.name: hook_invoke_expand
methods.description: Invokes the expand hook with specified parameters.
